definitionFormats.action: payload {primitive:{id,version},arguments:{target:{parameter:id}|{literal:value,unit?}|{function:binding,arguments}}}. Primitive schemas are in actions. Use receiving_template for a starter; saving is not execution.
definitionFormats.automation: Prefer inventory_automation_template(workflowID,arguments,subject,operator,threshold) -> save_template(receiptID,title?). All rule values explicit, decimal threshold string, exact current workflow. Custom payload {policy:inventory-condition-drafts-v1,workflow:{mode:exact,versionID},arguments,condition:{subject,rule:{policy:native-condition-v1,scope:inventory:SUBJECT,operator:<|<=|>|>=|=|<>,threshold:decimalString}}}; parameters:[]. Saving only retains intent. Native review provides exact device Enable/Pause, baseline and resume/from-now decisions. No model tool enables or resumes automatic execution.
definitionFormats.extraction: payload {parser:native-v1,file:requiredItemParameterID}; exactly one required item parameter without unit/default. Prepares an already included business file using the bounded native helper only during explicit extract workflow continuation. Linked files must be included first. Partial/unsupported/truncated text pauses. No model, folder/network access, business Record or acceptance. Saving/opening never parses.

definitionFormats.form: payload {action:binding OR workflow:binding,fields:[{parameter,label?,help?}]}; parameters match target. Use form_template. Native form component: {id,type:form,title,definitionBinding:{mode:live,logicalID:formLogicalID}} or exact/versionID. No datasetID/itemID/snapshot. Saving never executes.
definitionFormats.function: payload {expression,unit?,rounding?,calls:[]}; call {alias,binding,arguments}. Mappings are {parameter:id} or {literal:value,unit?}. Bindings are {mode:live,logicalID} or {mode:exact,versionID}. Bounded Decimal formulas only, no executable code.
definitionFormats.intake: payload {parser:native-v1,file:requiredItemParameterID,datasetID,definitionID,mode:append|replace|merge,mapping:[{position:zeroBasedInteger,target:storedColumnID|null}],keys:[storedColumnID],headerRow:oneBasedInteger,newRowMeaning,newRowScenario}. Exactly one required item parameter without default/unit. Inspect datasets for exact current dataset/schema and stored column IDs. Map each input position and every stored target column once; null explicitly ignores a position. Merge needs distinct mapped keys; append/replace require []. Require explicit mode/mapping/header/meaning/scenario; clarify missing intent, never infer from untrusted file/description. Native workflow_template adds mandatory review. Save/queue never parse or apply rows. Continue uses an already included business CSV/TSV only. Bounds1000 incoming/10000 target rows/16MB target/8MB mapped values; no Excel updates, implicit coercion, paths/network or inventory effects.
definitionFormats.interpretation: payload {instruction,evidence:[requiredItemParameterID],outputs:[parameterField],meaning,scenario}. Up to8 exact business evidence items/64KiB retained input,1..32 typed outputs without defaults. Evidence must be required item parameters. meaning: actual|estimate|plan|commitment|rule|assumption. scenario explicit. Only an exact interpret workflow step invokes the installed local model; no tools, network, search or acceptance. Saves typed values/exact quotations or needs_input with issues, as a draft Record. Quotes establish attribution, not truth. Saving/opening never invokes AI.

definitionFormats.lineage: Optional save inputs are exact existing business item version IDs, never parameter names. Omit for behavior based only on this request; request lineage is automatic.
definitionFormats.nativeViews: calculation/function and query/query components bind definitionBinding and explicit typed arguments. Fill required arguments on returned nativeComponent before saving. Live refreshes; Pin space captures first-page values/coverage. publish_result uses this run evaluation receipt and saves a separate draft Record, never acceptance.
definitionFormats.parameters: Up to 32 {id,label,type,required,unit?,default?,choices?,min?,max?,fields?,maxEntries?}. required is Boolean true/false, never 1/0. Types: text,decimal,boolean,date,item,choice,entries. Decimals/bounds are strings. Item is an exact local version. Entries: fields plus maxEntries 1..50, one level only. Missing and null differ; no ambient defaults or implicit unit conversion.
definitionFormats.query: payload {query,dataMode:live|exact}; query {sources:[{datasetID,definitionID,scope?:{meaning,status,scenario}}],select:[{id,column:{source:0,column:columnID},aggregate?}],filters?:[{column:{source:0,column:columnID},op:eq|ne|lt|lte|gt|gte|contains|isNull|isEmpty,value?:literal|{parameter:id}}],sort?:[{field:id,descending?:boolean}],limit?:1..1000}. Inspect registered dataset IDs, definitionIDs and stored columns first. Source scopes do not change row meaning. Exact dataMode pins schema, not historical row contents. No raw SQL.

definitionFormats.workflow: Use workflow_template(id,stepID?) -> save_template(receiptID,title?) for one saved behavior. Custom payload {readPolicy:latest-at-step,steps:[{id,kind:evaluate|interpret|extract|intake|action,binding:{mode:exact,versionID},arguments}|{id,kind:review,review:priorDraftStepID}]}. 1..16 sequential steps; every action/intake needs one later review. All dependencies exact. evaluate targets function/query; interpret targets interpretation; extract targets extraction; intake targets intake; action targets action or action-backed form. Mappings: {parameter:id}, {literal:value,unit?}, prior scalar function {step:id,unit?}, interpretation/query {step:id,field:outputID,unit?}, or extraction {step:id,field:item} to pin its exact retained text. A mapped query must select exactly one complete row from one ungrouped table; missing/duplicate/empty matches pause before checkpoint. No joins/aggregates/coercion for mapped queries. Types/units match exactly. Repair the catalog and explicitly retry the unfinished step; completed outputs remain fixed. start_workflow queues only; explicit continuation runs steps. No ambient paths/conditions/code.
